children: Australian shares were expected to open higher on Thursday, with potential gains in energy and gold stocks on the back of strong underlying commodity prices.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.4%, a 1-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark closed 1% lower on Wednesday.
